The test suite compiles successfully with `./compile.sh`.

## Summary

Created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/StringUtilsAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class with 138 `@Test` methods covering `org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils`. I derived every expectation directly from the javadoc in `api/` (constants, null-safety semantics, boundary values, and documented exceptions), reading through the full method list including deprecated-but-still-functional overloads, and verified several less-common methods (e.g. `indexOfAnyBut`, `indexOfDifference`, `isNoneBlank`/`isNoneEmpty`, `swapCase`, `toRootLowerCase`/`toRootUpperCase`) against the exact javadoc text rather than assumption.

Coverage includes: empty/blank checks, trim/strip family, equals/compare family, startsWith/endsWith family, indexOf/lastIndexOf/contains family, substring family, padding/centering, case conversion, character-class predicates (`isAlpha`, `isNumeric`, etc.), `join`/`split` families, `remove`/`replace` families, `chomp`/`chop`, `abbreviate`/`truncate`/`wrap`/`unwrap`, `reverse`/`rotate`/`difference`/`getCommonPrefix`/`getDigits`/`getLevenshteinDistance`, `overlay`, `length`, and `valueOf` — with explicit exception-case tests (`assertThrows`) for `abbreviate`, `truncate`, `getLevenshteinDistance`, `replaceEach`, `replaceEachRepeatedly`, and `joinWith`.
